t_d84a536ada0c: Can the same device provide every measurement?

t_aee91adcfa2f: Does PIR measure occupancy or provide personnel protection?

t_47579206fb8a: Can this connect to our BMS and control the HVAC?

t_12eee8f83664: How do water events and air-quality notifications differ?

t_06b4935a3d08: Does air-quality monitoring replace fire detection?

Fire detection, local warning and emergency response remain separate building provisions.
